feature: KB-195 (each project publishes only to its own channels)

mutations.name: P1 Publish Now sends to a channel outside the project
mutations.pattern: a channel that isn't one of the project's publishToAllAction refuses it

mutations.name: P2 a retry sends to a channel outside the project
mutations.pattern: a channel that isn't one of the project's retryPublishAction refuses it

mutations.name: P3 the Publish screen lists every team channel again
mutations.pattern: lists only the project's channels when given a project
